name: site100-worlds
description: 100 industry-specific responsive websites with distinct design fingerprints, art directions, comparison and customization tools.

scripts.check: node scripts/check.mjs && node --check src/enhance-fix.js && node --check src/copy.js && node --check src/copy-bootstrap.js && node --check src/art-direction.js && node --check scripts/postbuild.mjs && node --check scripts/art-build.mjs && node --check scripts/v3-audit.mjs
scripts.build: node scripts/build.mjs && node scripts/postbuild.mjs && node scripts/art-build.mjs
scripts.test: npm run check && npm run build && npm run audit
